subject: general
question: Which danseuse among the following was called to perform for Queen Elizabeth-II’s coronation festivities in 1953?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamala Lakshmi Narayanan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1953, **Kamala** was invited to perform at **Queen Elizabeth II's** coronation festivities. Kamala, also known as Kumari Kamala, is an Indian dancer and actress.
 
• She started her career as a child dancer and went on to appear in nearly 100 Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada films.
 
• In the 1970s, she transitioned into teaching the **Vazhuvoor style of dance,** specializing in this particular form.
 
• In 1970, the Government of India honored her with the Padma Bhushan, the country's third-highest civilian award.
 
• In 2010, she was bestowed with a National Heritage Fellowship from the National Endowment for the Arts in recognition of her significant contributions to the arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mrinalini Vikram Sarabhai,** renowned as an Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and instructor, founded and directed the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts in Ahmedabad. This esteemed institution offers training in various art forms such as dance, drama, music, and puppetry.
 
• **Sitara Devi,** an iconic figure in Indian classical dance, particularly Kathak, also excelled as a singer and actress. Her talent graced prestigious venues worldwide, including the Royal Albert Hall in London and the Carnegie Hall in New York, earning her numerous awards and accolades.
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale,** a theosophist, dancer, and Bharatanatyam choreographer was a trailblazer in Indian history. Not only was she a pioneer in promoting Bharatanatyam, but she also advocated for animal welfare. Rukmini Devi made history as the first woman to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Indian Parliament.
